frequency_question: How often do such major restrictive voting bills successfully pass the Senate within a comparable timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes major standalone federal bills altering voter registration or eligibility rules backed primarily by one party that reached floor consideration or serious debate over the past 30 years. Excludes routine appropriations or broad bipartisan omnibus election administration overhauls.
